title: SCM Layer Tests (Git/SVN)
description: Add and extend unit tests for SCM layer covering 5 modules: (1) create smart-diff-selector.test.ts with 4 scenarios (staged selection, unstaged fallback, auto mode, empty repo); (2) create staged-content-detector.test.ts with 3 scenarios (single-file staged, multi-file staged, no staged content); (3) create 2 new SVN test files (svn-provider.test.ts, svn-diff-helper.test.ts) covering SVN diff, status parsing, commit, streaming input; (4) extend multi-repository-context-manager.test.ts with path boundary safety and mixed SCM types.

criteria: 4 new test files created: [smart-diff-selector.test.ts, staged-content-detector.test.ts, svn-provider.test.ts, svn-diff-helper.test.ts] — verify by ls src/scm/__tests__/*.test.ts | wc -l >= 8
1 existing test file expanded: [multi-repository-context-manager.test.ts] — verify new test cases added
smart-diff-selector covers all 4 target modes: [staged, all, auto, empty] — verify by grep 'staged\|unstaged\|auto\|empty' in test file
SVN modules elevated from 0 to basic coverage — verify by npx vitest run src/scm/__tests__/svn
Path boundary matching tests cover edge cases: [/repo vs /repo-tools] — verify by grep 'boundary\|repo-tools' in test file
All tests pass — verify by npx vitest run src/scm (exit code 0)

rationale.why: SCM module has 143 changes and 3 bug fixes. SVN has zero tests. Path boundary matching (/repo vs /repo-tools) is highest regression risk.
rationale.approach: Create new test files for untested modules, extend existing multi-repo test with edge cases. Can parallelize with IMPL-002 since both depend only on IMPL-001.

risks.risk: SVN provider may have tight coupling to child_process making mocking difficult
risks.mitigation: Use vi.mock('child_process') at module level with vi.hoisted() for flexible response control
